maya: Nightly seqlen-aware harness run finished. Posting short summary.

maya: Run id: nightly-3755552468
maya: Quick highlights:
- microbench: 512/1024 sequences show alt-kernel pick for Ampere
- KV cache hit regression (small) on 256 window in q8 path
- CI: 1 candidate kernel failed on AVX2 longseq test

maya: Full micro output:```csv
kernel,arch,seqlen,lat_ms
altloop,ampere,512,2.3
altloop,ampere,1024,3.8
baseline,ampere,512,2.6
baseline,ampere,1024,4.0
q8-kv,ampere,256,1.1
q8-kv,ampere,256,1.25 # regression
``` 

arjun: Thanks. Do we have flamegraphs for the q8 path? the 1.25->1.1 looks small but maybe noise.

maya: yes attached in run artifacts -> https://internal-gcs/runs/nightly-3755552468/flame-q8-256.svg
maya: flame shows extra memcpy in kv-merge step for q8-kv when seqlen==256

dave: perf-bot showed AVX2 failure: test name kern-ci/longseq-avx2-3. Can someone paste logs?

perf-bot: [automated] Run nightly-ci/3755552468: 1 failed, 32 passed. Failing step: kern-ci/longseq-avx2-3

maya: logs:```bash
[ERROR] assertion failed: latency > threshold
trace: src/kernels/avx2_longloop.cpp:line 218
cmd: ./kbench --arch avx2 --kernel altloop --seqlen 2048 --iters 100
``` 

linh: I reproduced locally on an older ampere image (docker:prod-2026-01). The AVX2 codepath had a stride change causing cache thrash. pushing a quick revert to candidate branch.

arjun: For KV cache regression, could we add a tiny prefault to avoid memcpy? Also add the q8-kv 256 case to microbench smoke matrix.

maya: Agreed. Action items:
- @linh: revert AVX2 stride change and re-run kernel-ci (ETA 1h)
- @arjun: PR with prefault probe + add microbench case (ETA EOD)
- @dave: add flaky guard in perf CI to rerun failing longseq step once before marking failure (low-risk)

dave: I'll post a short note in the CI infra board and add the rerun hook.

maya: Creating follow-up issue: https://go/issue/RED-7891 (contains artifacts, logs, triage notes)

maya: If nobody objects, I'll promote altloop as candidate for ampere-1024 pick but block q8-kv until prefault fix.

arjun: :thumbsup:

linh: I'll open the revert PR now.

maya: thanks team. Keeping this thread as the canonical triage for tonight's run.
